diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build-signing/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build-signing/kind.yml

--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build-signing/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build-signing/kind.yml
@@ -22,8 +22,9 @@ only-for-attributes:
 not-for-build-platforms:
     - macosx64-shippable/opt
     - macosx64/opt
-    - macosx64-rust/opt

+    - macosx64-aarch64/debug
 
 tasks:
     build-signing:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build/macosx.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build/macosx.yml
index c370025b104..a4639528aa4 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build/macosx.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build/macosx.yml
@@ -131,6 +131,69 @@ macosx64-x64-shippable/opt:
             - macosx64-sdk
             - terser
 
+macosx64-aarch64/debug:
+    description: "MacOS X Aarch64 Cross-compile"
+    index:
+        job-name: macosx64-aarch64-debug
+    attributes:
+        enable-build-signing: true
+        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
+    treeherder:
+        platform: osx-cross-aarch64/debug
+        symbol: B
+        tier: 1
+    worker:
+        max-run-time: 5400
+        env:
+            MOZ_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE_TESTS: "1"
+            PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: aarch64
+    run:
+        config:
+            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
+            - builds/releng_base_mac_64_cross_builds.py
+        custom-build-variant-cfg: cross-debug
+        mozconfig-variant: debug
+        extra-config:
+            extra_mozconfig_content:
+                - ac_add_options --target=aarch64-apple-darwin
+    use-sccache: true
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux64-sccache
+            - macosx64-x64-libotr
+            - macosx64-sdk
+
+macosx64-aarch64/opt:
+    description: "MacOS X Aarch64 Cross-compile"
+    index:
+        job-name: macosx64-aarch64-opt
+    attributes:
+        enable-build-signing: true
+        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
+    treeherder:
+        platform: osx-cross-aarch64/opt
+        symbol: B
+        tier: 1
+    worker:
+        max-run-time: 7200
+        env:
+            MOZ_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE_TESTS: "1"
+            PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: aarch64
+    run:
+        config:
+            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
+            - builds/releng_base_mac_64_cross_builds.py
+        extra-config:
+            extra_mozconfig_content:
+                - ac_add_options --target=aarch64-apple-darwin
+    use-sccache: true
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux64-sccache
+            - macosx64-x64-libotr
+            - macosx64-sdk
+            - terser
+
 macosx64-aarch64-shippable/opt:
     description: "MacOS X aarch64 Cross-compile"
     attributes:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/repackage/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/repackage/kind.yml
index 35ec784c36f..3ecfb2146cc 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/repackage/kind.yml

@@ -24,6 +24,8 @@ only-for-build-platforms:
     - macosx64-shippable/opt
     - macosx64/opt
     - macosx64/debug
+    - macosx64-aarch64/opt
+    - macosx64-aarch64/debug
     - win32-shippable/opt
     - win64-shippable/opt

         - xpcshell-tests

+macosx1500-aarch64/debug:
+    build-platform: macosx64-aarch64/debug

+        - marionette-tests
+        - mochitest-tests
+        - xpcshell-tests

+macosx1500-aarch64/opt:

+    build-signing-label: repackage-macosx64-aarch64/opt
+    test-sets:
+        - marionette-tests
+        - mochitest-tests
+        - xpcshell-tests
